text:
Priya: Heads up — I'm sketching the rollout console for automatic switchover during surge events. Quick UX q: how many degrade-mode choices should we surface vs keep behind an "advanced" panel? Operators need a fast path for overrides.

Liam: I'd keep 3 visible presets: quiet (sample a few requests), soft (short TTL + partial redirect), hard (full redirect). Show sampling rate and last-trigger reason inline.

Jess: +1. Also we need a compact "why it switched" panel: event id, trigger metric, brief payload preview. Helps SREs triage without clicking into logs.

Dana: Can we show the last 3 triggers with timestamps and a play button to open the audit playback? Defaults: quiet sampling 0.1%, soft 1%, hard 100% redirect.

Priya: Thinking of an inline toggle: [Auto-switchover: ON/OFF] + presets dropdown + small policy JSON preview. CC @rollout-bot for telemetry keys/naming.

rollout-bot: policy-saved: id=pol_1722, triggers=[latency>1200ms,error_rate>5%], sampling=0.01

Liam: We should add an estimated quota/cost impact calc next to each preset: "tokens/day delta if redirected" so product folks know bill implications.

Jess: Edge case: transient spikes — add hysteresis window + minimum duration before engaging. UI should let you tune it but default to 60s. Also allow a "cooldown" so it won't flip back immediately.

Priya: Draft JSON for the policy preview (small, read-only by default):
```json
{"id":"pol_1722","auto_sw":true,"modes":{
  "quiet":{"sampling":0.001,"hysteresis_s":60},
  "soft":{"sampling":0.01,"redirect_pct":25,"min_duration_s":120},
  "hard":{"sampling":1.0,"redirect_pct":100,"min_duration_s":300}
},"triggers":[{"metric":"p95_latency_ms","op":"gt","value":1200},{"metric":"error_rate_pct","op":"gt","value":5}] }
```

Dana: Ops question: when an operator manually overrides auto-switchover, do we require a reason note? I'd prefer yes for >10min overrides so audit logs have context.

Jess: Agreed — require a short reason for manual stays longer than 10 minutes. Add a tiny inline banner: "Operator override: Jess — 12m — reason: investigating model regressions".

Priya: UX note: show a small pill with current mode + human name if manual, otherwise show trigger metric + sample rate. Also add a link "open audit" that takes you to playback with the event id preselected.

Liam: For telemetry naming, standardize like: rollout.auto_switched -> {policy_id, mode, trigger, sample_rate, operator=null|name}. That makes downstream grouping easy.

rollout-bot: telemetry-registered: event=rollout.auto_switched, keys=[policy_id,mode,trigger,sample_rate,operator,event_id]

Priya: Thanks — I'll update the figma with these flows and add a tiny prototype for the "why it switched" drilldown. Will open a PR that includes the API field additions (hysteresis_s, min_duration_s, operator_reason).

Jess: 👀 Nice. +1 on requiring reason for long overrides.

Dana: :+1: I'll flag with SRE to validate defaults and sampling.

Priya: Great, will follow up with links once PR + mock are up. Thanks everyone!
